name: True Detective
description: True Detective is a benchmark of 191 long-form mystery narratives designed to test deep abductive reasoning in language models. It includes multiple-choice questions and is challenging for state-of-the-art models like GPT-4, with human performance significantly higher than model performance.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the literature that is gaining attention for probing deep abductive reasoning, but it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Only 47% of humans solve puzzles successfully on average; GPT-3 barely outperforms random and GPT-4 achieves 38% accuracy.
